# Arista AVD

> Arista AVD (Architect, Validate, Deploy) automates network configuration, documentation, deployment, and validation for Arista EOS networks. It provides the arista.avd Ansible collection and the PyAVD Python library for data center, campus, and wide area networks.

This index covers the documentation version in which it is published. Resolve relative links against this file's URL, preserving the version path. Use documentation matching the installed arista.avd and PyAVD versions; these packages are co-versioned. The stable documentation tracks the current stable release, while devel describes development code. Consult the porting guide when upgrading across major versions.

Key concepts:

- AVD Design is the network-wide intent model consumed by eos_designs, which produces per-device structured configuration and fabric documentation.
- EOS Config is the device configuration model consumed by eos_cli_config_gen, which renders EOS CLI configuration and device documentation. Use the custom structured configuration guide to override or extend eos_designs output with EOS Config data.
- Configuration generation runs offline. Deployment and operational validation are separate workflows with their own roles and requirements.
- PyAVD exposes Python functions for validation and generation; callers provide inventory and variable management. Use the documented public API and check its limitations.

The links below lead to rendered HTML documentation, including expanded schema tables and API references. Raw repository Markdown can contain unexpanded includes or API directives. For a variable, consult its data-model reference for nesting, types, defaults, constraints, and deprecations, then use the relevant how-to or example for context. The data-model references are large; search for the relevant key or section. The interactive Schema Explorer requires JavaScript; the linked data-model references contain the schema documentation as page content.

## Data models and configuration generation

- [AVD Design data models](ansible_collections/arista/avd/roles/eos_designs/docs/data-models.html): Network intent inputs for eos_designs, with schema tables and YAML examples.
- [EOS Config data models](ansible_collections/arista/avd/roles/eos_cli_config_gen/docs/data-models.html): Device-level structured configuration inputs for eos_cli_config_gen, with schema tables and YAML examples.
- [eos_designs role](ansible_collections/arista/avd/roles/eos_designs/index.html): Supported designs, inputs, outputs, and links to role configuration.
- [eos_cli_config_gen role](ansible_collections/arista/avd/roles/eos_cli_config_gen/index.html): Rendering structured configuration into EOS CLI and device documentation.
- [Custom structured configuration](ansible_collections/arista/avd/roles/eos_designs/docs/how-to/custom-structured-configuration.html): Extending or overriding generated configuration, including precedence and merge behavior.
